reviews.name: Radhakrishnan Mayappan
reviews.text:
Excellent car accessories shop with a wide range of quality products. The staff is knowledgeable, friendly, and always ready to guide you with the right suggestions. Prices are reasonable and the service is quick.

They explained every product clearly and helped me choose the right accessories for my car. Installation was neat and professional.

The quality is impressive and the team maintains high standards in service. Perfect place for premium upgrades.

reviews.name: Shashikant Ayapila
reviews.text:
I recently visited Bumper to Bumper in Vanumpet to get seat covers fitted in my favorite color, and I must say, the entire experience was truly amazing! The craftsmanship and attention to detail were outstanding. The team did a flawless job with the fitting — everything was neat, precise, and done with great care.

A special mention to Rajesh, the proprietor — he was incredibly kind, generous, and friendly throughout the process. It's rare to come across someone so passionate about what they do and equally committed to customer satisfaction.
